text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Hello-san. What does
the Grand Live mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, not as an Umamusume, but as a fan—I'd really love to hear your answer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...You were a fan too,
wanting to watch someone's stage, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...What the Grand Live
means to the fans."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you as always,
this is Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Is it over here?"

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're here, they're here!
Hey, when are we doing the Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Man Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I always look forward to the concerts held here.
Is there anything I can do to help out?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: "If you have any posters or anything, I'd love to display them in my shop..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: These people are...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The fans'...

text_block_list.name: Fan in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
It's a concert where anyone can perform, right?
I was wondering if maybe my favorite might show up...

text_block_list.name: Fan in a Chef's Hat
text_block_list.text:
I want to help. Usually,
all I can do is just watch.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I heard you're gathering helpers.
I know you're looking for Umamusume, but..."

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Fan
text_block_list.text: I wonder if we could become collaborators too!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...So many people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Visiting fans call out to her one after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At first, it was a concert meant to gather more Umamusume collaborators, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By now, her fame and popularity
had spread far beyond the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
May we start the concert once more?
For these people's sake as well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"—Starting from this concert,
I have a request for all of you."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'd like to change the format just a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: How are you going to change it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...They'll make plenty of noise.
The fans, that is."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "It might get noisier than usual. It might be a little hard to hear things."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We have already notified the fans, the sound crew, and the local authorities regarding that matter.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That is why... please listen.
Listen to the voices of your fans.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...Please, you have to make the Grand Live a reality!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Of course, if the Umamusume I'm cheering for stands at the center of the Winning Live,
nothing would make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: "Still, 'congratulations' isn't the only feeling we want to share."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. Because we had feelings beyond that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the concert began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Smart Falcon and the others step onto the stage—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"L-O-V-E Lovely! Falco!
Her fan service is divine! The #1 umadol to support!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I looooove you when you shine the absolute brightest...!!
I really, truly love you so muchーー!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, you were my dream!
Always strong, beautiful, and never giving up!
To me... you were the dream itself!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon...! Lady Tachyon...!
Please let me accompany you to that boundless place.
No, at least let me watch over you!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Suzukaaa! Thank you for appearing
before us once again!"

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Just that alone makes us happy...!

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all so much...!
Everyone, thank youuu...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
W-What's wrong,
Bourbon-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know.
I don't know, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am... happy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I am sure we both have
many things we wish to say to each other today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Let's sing together.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer. As expected, I really want to bring back the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "We want to convey our gratitude to those girls, too... directly from the fans."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will revise it once more.
The 'Grand Live Revival Plan'.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Not just for umamusume.
As a live performance meant for both umamusume and fans.

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Those people... are singing again.
Why won't they understand...?

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Aren't you... going to sing?

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...And you?
